record.title: Evaluate Linux link evidence and choose the next bounded acquisition preparation
record.intent: Advance from standard transport proof to the smallest useful RF continuation.
requirements: Independently inspect actual raw capture, DHCP negotiation/options, one raw SCPI identity and recorder/helper closure or exact stop. Preserve clock translation bounds and distinguish host readiness, specimen reachability and unmeasured RF response.

If standard transport is supported, draft the smallest conventional ADB/epoch and RF-source integration preparation needed for one stopped waveform, preserving original application/native/protected corpus and existing RF comparison evidence. Any USB source relocation is an explicit operator wiring transition. No automatic reboot, broad retry, protected writes or old-controller resumption is admitted by this decision.

Plan and inspect any successor mutation, admit against the expected revision and commit/push tasking before execution. Close or retain the stopped Mac branch through explicit taskctl disposition rather than rewriting immutable evidence. Respect the current RF time boundary unless the operator renews it.
acceptance: Actual standard transport evidence or an exact limitation supports a bounded next action.
